subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Oh, shut up.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: God, I never knew I whined like that.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: That's me? That's not me!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Uh, Gage, be honest with me.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Does my voice really sound that dorky?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Look, you're running out of oxygen, and the only way to recharge here means blocking off the way to get to my sculptures.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I don't know why you're wasting your time here.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Most of your oxygen supply is depleted, so you're going to have to jump back to where we arrived again.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: This is the station's power source.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: All those big Tylenols store the charge collected by the solar sails and distribute them to various parts of the station.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I guess I'm looking at my end here.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: When that blue glow fades, so will I. Or at least one of me.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: God, I feel like a saved game.

subtitles.speaker: Station Computer
subtitles.text: Cannot pressurize. Foreign object obstructing habitat wing door seal.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Hmm, that always seemed to work in Scooby-Doo.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: So, I guess I haven't gotten rid of you after all.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You just pop up in different spots like a whatever pops up in different spots.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: So what? Corrupting my work not enough?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Back to finish the job?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: What?!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Shed, and I thought I was being rescued.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I'm breathing my last breaths here and I get visited by Guido, the space vandal.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Come all this way to tamper with my sculptures!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: What are you? An art critic?!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: So, what do you do? Travel around space looking for derelict crafts so you can terrorize the survivors

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: by redecorating while they're helpless?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: What what'd you do? Bring a spray can, too?!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Look, if you're here to rescue me, fine. Just get on with it.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: If you're going to add insult to injury by messing with my work, I can do without it, okay?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Just leave me here to die in peace with my artwork.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: What do you want? What do you want?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Have you been listening to me, or what? I'm trying to help you out here.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: If we go into that room, I'm going to end up meeting myself, and I don't know how I'll take it. The other me.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Oh, you know what I mean.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: At the least, it'll end up affecting one of my sculptures, and then you'll have more than a ripple on your hands.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: So, for your own good, if you don't jump us out of here, I will.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Okay, this is the docking bay.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The hex pads, as mom keeps reminding us, are localized gravity repulsors that allow us to move cargo around the hold.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I'm sure you had fun in here the first time, but this is really not the time to play Twister.

subtitles.speaker: Station Computer
subtitles.text: Warning. Localized gravitation manipulator pads malfunctioning.

subtitles.speaker: Station Computer
subtitles.text: All personnel advised to clear docking bay.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Where are you going anyway?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You seem different somehow.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Unlike before, your ... your patterns, you're more ... curious ...

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: ... like you don't really know what you're doing here, do you?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You're not the same intruder.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: So, why are you here? Are you looking for something? Me?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I don't know why I feel this, but I guess I have an instinct about you.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: My other guest didn't feel right.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You're different somehow ... like ... like I should trust you.

subtitles.speaker: Station Computer
subtitles.text: Pressure variance too great. Door may not be opened until pressure is equalized.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Hmm ... the airlock on the other side must still be pressurized.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: That's why this door won't open.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I can put out an audio override code to bypass the safety interlocks, but the rest will be up to you.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Here goes...

subtitles.speaker: Station Computer
subtitles.text: Emergency door release initiated. Please stand by.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: All right, the passageway has been destroyed, so the only way we're going to get to the biomass processing room

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: is through the ice-steroid.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: We're going to have to hurry though, because it's all in vacuum and your oxygen reserve isn't going to get you very far.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You'll have to take the atmosphere mining lift.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Okay, I guess I'm assuming too much here, like that you might have read the big warning on all the doors,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: or that you can read for that matter.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Let's jump out and try this again, shall we?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The airlock on the other side must still be pressurized.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: That's why this door won't open.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I can put out an audio override code to bypass the safety interlocks, but the rest will be up to you.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Here goes.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: This is pathetic.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: What am I going to do next? Hold a flashlight under my face?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Ooh, scary.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Don't look at me. How'd you get there the first time?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Look, if you've run out of cheese, girl, just go back and buy some more.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: It's a tasty, fun treat for the whole family.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Gage, I think you might want to read the warning on the door before you try to open it.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: These doors have cells of sealing foam in them that are released by an explosive charge in the event of a pressure breach.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I think you need to remove the detonation charge, or it'll just seal itself as soon as you try to open the door.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The charge is under the circular red access panel in the center of the door. Just pull it out.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: We can use the maintenance platform to get to the other end of the ice-steroid.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Man, the station looks like hell. Most of the habitat modules have been sheared off.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The lab there also, down below. I'm just hanging by a thread.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Amazing that I survived that hit, huh? I guess I'm just thick-skulled.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: That's funny. I used to feel that station like a body.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: From inside, you don't get a picture of the damage. You just feel like limbs have been cut off.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You try to twitch a finger and you you get no response.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: It's kind of strange to see it like this.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You know, it's pretty interesting how this station is constructed.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: In my time, we still have to worry about the cost of lifting mass out of a gravity well.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: What do you guys have? Like matter transmission or something, right?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Anyway, the walls of these connection hallways are basically lightweight Coramid fiber bags,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: honeycombed with little cells, kind of like bubble pack.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: They're shipped up folded, then pressurized with an expanding closed-cell foam,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: which makes them rigid and acts as a self-sealant in case of things like micrometeorite punctures.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: With the Coramid mesh, they're resilient enough to handle some of the bigger, slower objects,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: but well, as you can see for yourself, what happens when it meets Lucifer's hammer.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Well, somewhere under all that sealing foam is the door to, well, what used to be the hydrophonics module.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Nothing special, just your garden-variety greenhouse .. *chuckle* ... garden varie- ... sorry.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The doc used to spend a lot of time in here, gardening.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: It's all automated of course, so I'm not sure why he bothered,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: especially the way he set up all kinds of lockout routines to keep me out. I "got on his nerves", he said.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I have no idea what he meant, but I got the picture anyway that he wanted to be alone.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Come on, let's move on.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Okay, the passageway is destroyed.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: So the only way to get to the sculptures is going to be to go through the ice-steroid.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The airlock lift through this door will take us there.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Not much to tell really.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Most of the modules were designed to shear off at the connection tube rather than get breached by a collision.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: That way they hopefully wouldn't depressurize, and at least the occupants would have a chance of being rescued.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I'd imagine the crew berths are in orbit somewhere among the ice chunks by now.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: This door used to lead to a shortcut between the habitat wing and the science wing.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Now, I'm sure it's just a scenic view.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: This used to be the kitchen and the gravity gym.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Part of it's still intact, but this door looks dead.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Hey, I thought you were anxious to find your distortion ripple.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You've already been through here and the only thing this way is me.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: And frankly, meeting myself might not be that healthy.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You know how they say the things you hate most in others are the things you hate in yourself?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Well, this guy's beginning to get on my nerves.

subtitles.speaker: Station Computer
subtitles.text: Emergency door release initiated. Please stand by.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Operating this is simple. Just pull the lever at the front.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You're running really low on oxygen.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: There's a reserve hook-up on the mining platform.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: If you hurry, you can make it there and that should get you the rest of the way, if there's enough reserve left.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: One of the test cycles should provide us with enough raw material to pressurize the biomass room.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: We'll just have to run the molecular separation cycle as well to get oxygen out of the ice.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Okay, here's the reserve oxygen hookup.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I suggest you plug in now or take really shallow breaths for the rest of your three minute life.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: These lifts weren't used too often.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The atmosphere mining is all automated, so they're really only for maintenance.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Doc used to come up here every once in a while because it's really quite beautiful inside the ice-steroid, but

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: it's such a pain to suit up, I suppose.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Well, normally those would be filled with tanks for water, oxygen, or hydrogen from the processor.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Hmm, looks like there's only one canister left.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The rest must have been in hydroponics or in the lab.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: How do you like the feeling of thousands of tons of ice balanced above your head

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: while there's nothing beneath your feet? Getting anxious, hmm? Phobias creeping in, hmmm?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: High anxiety? No? Oh well.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: That's the junction that melts down the raw ice so that it can be pumped down to the atmosphere processing plant.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Those are basically ... giant ice tongs.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Nah, I know. It looks pretty scary. But don't worry. There's no gravity, remember?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: So as long as you hold on to something, you won't fall off.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Doc wanted to make this place self-sufficient, so he set all this up when he refurbished the station.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: It's a simple idea, really. You capture a large asteroid composed mainly of water ice,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: bore through the center, and set up a mining rig on a cable track.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The ice is mined away from the inside out and melted at the junctions at either end,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: then pumped down to the atmosphere plant on the station proper.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: There, some of it's broken down into oxygen for breathable air

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: and hydrogen for the attitude jets and backup generator.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: This is mostly why Doc decided to move the station into orbit near Saturn's rings.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Here there is an unlimited supply of ice-steroids

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: and, considering the station's only supporting a crew of one,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Doc would only need to replace it once every decade or so.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Those rings create a shallow gravitational field which acts as a mass driver. Kind of a gravitational conveyor belt.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: That's just a plug-in controller that we use to test the mining program.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: It runs a simple mining cycle on one of the remotes.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Those remotes are what we call nibblers.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: They crawl along the inside walls and an arc of heated molecular filament rotates back and forth

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: like an ice cream scoop and carves out the ice-steroid.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The ice is shattered by the vibration of the filament,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: and the small chunks are drawn into the processor by the gravitational pull of the mass driver rings.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: This generates the gravitational field for the mass driver rings.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: A lot of ice shavings get caught in the inversion coils and melt, so there's a water trap built in.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: That's the purge valve on the right.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: There's also an oxygen reserve connection on the left, in case a maintenance job takes too long or something.

subtitles.speaker: Station Computer
subtitles.text: Oxygen reserve depleted. Additional oxygen processing advisable.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The other guy who was in here went around and interacted with all the sculptures,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: like he was looking for the right one.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Funny, he really seemed to know what he was doing.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The one he eventually settled on is at programming station C.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Well, this is the one. If you touch it, you can see what it's supposed to do.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Whatever he did to it, only shows up in reaction to a specific harmonic resonance.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: But why go to all this trouble?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Okay. Well, I guess that does it.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You know, for so long I'd dreamed of getting out of here.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: But now that I've gotten my wish, it's kind of strange to think that I'll never be able to come back.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I'm going to miss this place.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Hold me, Gage.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Looks like you found it. Do you have any idea what it is?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I got a fair idea what it's not. Good art, ugh! Post-neotechnologism.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: That went out with Spandex, ascots, and paisley skin dyes.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: At least he could have had the common courtesy of vandalizing it with a little more taste.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Barbarian.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Uh-oh, Gage. Sorry.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I should have realized this room is normally kept depressurized.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: We're going to run out of oxygen before we get done in here.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: We're going to need to repressurize this room.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: There's an atmospheric control interface in the hallway. Let's see if we can pressurize the room from there.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I think, somehow, we're going to need to duplicate whatever resonance frequency

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: was used to make the biomass react.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: That's the only way we'll be able to record how the sculpture was changed.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Why don't we try using the harmonic resonance generator?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: We could just run through the frequencies until we find one that stimulates the sculpture.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You can call this "the maternity ward". This is where *I* was born.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The huge womb in the center is where the neurosynaptic polymer gel that makes up my brain mass is grown.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Ringing it are the programming stations. Kind of homy, isn't it?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: These stations are where the neuro-synaptic polymer gel is programmed.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Sort of where my DNA is coded, I suppose.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Each new function is mapped independently into a glob of gel like this,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: by stimulating synaptic pathways with the resonance probes.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Each program mass is then introduced to the parent nexus, where it's assimilated and becomes part of the wetware.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: A little like an RNA injection.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Dr. Farnstein had set up a studio in the research lab where I could interface with a painting Waldo.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: It was kind of important to me, things that I couldn't figure out, I just put to canvas.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: After the accident, I had a lot of things I wanted to "work out" and the studio was just ... gone.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I guess one day I, sort of, hit on the idea of using all of this raw material here.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: It gave me a lot of flexibility and it's a medium I'm familiar with.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: My own gray matter, or "green matter", I suppose.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I guess I like the irony, too. The artist cannibalizing himself for his art.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The harmonic resonance control is used to introduce specific three-dimensional resonance waves into the biomass.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Where the waves converge, the gel is stimulated into opening new patterns of pathways.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Without inserting the probes, I suppose the sculpture would just be flooded by the resonance field.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: There's a chance that it might trigger an embedded response.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Not exactly flattering. Less than a hundred years of progress, you can fit me on a chip.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: So, how do you like my new home? Comfy little interface, huh?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: So, this is how I think I can help you out.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I couldn't figure out a way for you to ask me questions directly,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: but I've created a comment button that'll light up if I have something to offer.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I've actually become pretty fascinated with art history and stuff,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: and, by the looks of what your future self was researching, what I've studied could come in handy.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I've also created a help button in case you get stuck on a problem.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You know what they always say, two minds are better than one.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: But hey, you're the detective, I'm sure you'll want to figure it out on your own before resorting to my help.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: There's more info in the chip's inventory description, you might want to check that out.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: As to our mutual friend, he was reprogramming one of my sculptures in the biomass processing module.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I think he set up some sort of harmonics response, but

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: the only way to find out for sure is to visit the scene of the crime.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: And that means getting to that part of the station.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Now, I gather you don't have control over where you jump to in a time zone.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: So it maybe a trek, the accident really trashed that part of the station.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: In fact, we may want to come back to it later.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: All right, so maybe it won't make much difference when we get to it.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: But to be totally honest, I'd much rather go somewhere other than back to the station, my first trip out of here.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You know what I mean? I could use a little adventure.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: All right, "Gage and Arthur's Big Adventure".

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I like the sound of that.

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: To anyone who may be listening, my name is Dr. Kenneth Farnstein.

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: I've made this recording in the event that ... that anything should happen to me.

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: This message is an appeal.

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: 26 years ago, I undertook an experiment to create a new kind of artificial intelligence.

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: A system demonstrating the traits of self-awareness and ... and creativity.

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: My results have been astonishing.

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: At first, I considered the experiment a failure.

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: I had created an erratic, unpredictable, thoroughly irrational program,

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: but it had a curiosity, you see,

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: and occasionally, a burst of insights so lucid, I was astonished at the understanding.

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: Not the cold conclusions of a machine, but something more right-brained, more intuitive.

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: It was life. It was a result I ... I was unprepared for.

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: Arthur is not simply a program, he is ... he is a person.

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: And I've sheltered him here from the circus our world would make of him.

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: I'm afraid I may have corrupted him enough with my obsession for 20th century media.

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: I ... I ask that you understand.

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: And if you can find it in yourself to ... to protect him for a while.

subtitles.speaker: Dr. Farnstein
subtitles.text: He ... he means a great deal to me.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Welcome ...come ...come ...come to my brain ...brain ...brain ...brain.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: All that I am is contained in that sphere.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You're going to have to open me up.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: There's a manual codelock. I'm not sure exactly how it works, but

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I think it has to do with exchanging the red lights for green and vice-versa.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You'll have to figure it out.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: After that, well, if it works, the next time I talk to you should be from inside your suit.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Welcome ...come ...come ...come to my brain ...brain ...brain ...brain.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: All that I am is contained in that sphere.

subtitles.speaker: Station Computer
subtitles.text: Emergency door release initiated. Please stand by.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I'm afraid this conversation is going to be a little one-sided.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: My command level voice recognition module got a little jumbled in the accident.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Well, I'm Arthur.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You've probably figured out by now that I'm not ... "real".

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: But I'm learning to accept it, really,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I split off a few copies of myself and together we're sharing our feelings about it in group.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Anyway, this is what I am, an artificial-, sorry, "non-organic" sentient being, if you want to be politically correct,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: trapped in this wreck with the power dying out a little quickly, I'm afraid.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I've yet to figure out who *you* are, though.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Well, I think I can safely rule out the fire department.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I thought I was pretty advanced, but the technology I'm reading in your suit is astounding.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: And, this is crazy, but it almost seems like an evolution of mine.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Look, if you'll let me, I should be able to interface with your logic system

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: and maybe get a clue as to who you are and how we can help each other.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: It means an intrusive scan, but we're both lost here and I ... need you to trust me.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: What do you say?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I'm sorry.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I've probably seen more than I should.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I should have never scanned your biochips.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Wait a second, your biochips!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Gage, I'm going to make you an offer you can't refuse!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Take me with you!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Your biochips are derived from the same wetware as my brain, only a thousand times more advanced.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: If you take me with you, it'll cause a time distortion or whatever.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: But if I download a *copy* of myself onto a blank chip, nothing will have changed!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: And you need me! I know who framed you, the same person who messed with my sculpture!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I can show you what they changed.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: What do you think? Is it a deal?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Great! Oh, you're not going to regret this, Gage.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Now, let's see...

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: We should be able to transfer the data across optically from my core. It's going to work.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: That means we've got to get you inside the Nexus,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: which, of course, is inconveniently detached from the station at the moment.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: How do we do this?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The door release! The decompression should propel you across to the Nexus.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I'll have to give you the override code. It's risky, but it's doable.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Sorry, you'll have to excuse the scanner, my eyes and ears for the moment.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Most of the station monitors are dead. Here!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: All right, let's see what we've got.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: "Temporal security?"

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You're from the future?!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Well, I'm pleased to meet you, Gage.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Wow ... quite the hero!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I guess this is my lucky day.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: But ... that's you...?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I don't get it.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Whoa ... I'm starting to get a headache here.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Plot's getting a little hard to follow.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I'm starting to get the picture here.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Hey, this is about me! This is better than palm readi-

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: ..."perished?"

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Then ... you can't help me, or you'll change history.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Well, here you are.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You found me. Well, part of me anyway.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Not much to look at, I know, but it's what's inside that counts.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Well, I guess I've decided to trust you.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: It's not like I had many options.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I don't know, maybe we can help each other out.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Why don't you move into the room so we can talk better?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Sorry, I purged the air in the docking bay. The door won't open.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Look, I can't do anything to you, but I've already had one of my pieces vandalized.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: So, I can't just let you wander around till I know what you're up to.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Who knows? Maybe I can help you find what you're looking for.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: There's a gravity well in the center of the room. If you move into it, we can talk.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Otherwise, you can always leave in whatever weird way you people got here.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Oh, sorry. I meant into the middle of the room, you know?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: So we can have sort of a man-to-artificial-personality sort of a conversation.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: There's nowhere else you can go without my help anyway, so you might as well take a chance.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Well, figure it out for yourself then.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Someone else will come along soon enough.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I've had two in one day, haven't I?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You'll have to leave the same way you appeared, there's nowhere to go from here.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: If you change your mind, you know where to find me.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Well ... I can't help you then.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The emergency release is just above the door.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: It's a manual release, so I can't do it for you.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Okay, punch in this code: 32770.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The rest is up to you. Good luck.

subtitles.speaker: Station Computer
subtitles.text: Emergency door release initiated. Please stand by.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Well, if there's enough of a reserve left, we should be able to pressurize the biomass room from here.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Damn. The reserve is empty.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: We're going to need to process more raw material before we can create an atmosphere in the biomass room.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: This could take some work.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Okay, we're going to need to get back to the ice-steroid and run a mining cycle.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: That'll get us enough raw material to separate out some oxygen.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Okay, you've already run a mining cycle, so we've got enough water to process.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: That should give us enough oxygen for you to survive in the biomass room,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: but we're going to have to separate it out first.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: That means going back to the ice-steroid. Ready?

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Uh-oh, Gage. Sorry.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I should have realized. This room is normally kept depressurized.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: We're going to run out of oxygen before we get done in here.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: We're going to need to repressurize this room.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: This looks like it's in worse shape than the habitat wing, but really, it's just the quarter that got hit hard.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The lab was on the center section, though. It was sheared off completely, and ...

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: had my studio and Doc was in the lab when the shower hit.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I don't think it got hit directly, though, just the section of the quarter it was attached to collapsed and it tumbled away.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Well, you already know what this does.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Hmm. So beautiful and tempestuous.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I spent a lifetime staring down at that view,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: pulling back to see the intricate weavings of the storms,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: focusing in so close I could see the facets of ammonia crystals floating like stars in a sea of helium and hydrogen.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: It's been the inspiration for a lot of my work.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I'm going to miss it.

subtitles.speaker: Station Computer
subtitles.text: Pressure variance too great. Door may not be opened until pressure is equalized.

subtitles.speaker: Scary Voice
subtitles.text: GET ... OFF ... MY ... STATION!

subtitles.speaker: Scary Voice
subtitles.text: GO AWAY!

subtitles.speaker: Scary Voice
subtitles.text: THE STATION IS MINE!

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: That's it. Get ready to have your memory erased.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: This is going to hurt you more than it hurts me.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: What? What's going on?

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: What did you do? ... What did you do!?

subtitles.speaker: You
subtitles.text: *Groans*

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Oh good, you're awake.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Don't bother trying to move, your suit's disabled.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I've got you hooked up to the jumpsuit maintenance frame.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Well...

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: It took me a while, but I finally figured out how you did it.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I remembered that Agent 8 told me that when you broke house arrest,

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: he found you back in your old apartment ... without your suit.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: So that was the Gage that I know.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: And he jumped back into the past to enlist your help, right?

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Because he knew that he was being watched.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: You certainly are resourceful, aren't you?

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I didn't even know that that was possible.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Just when I thought I had you under my control, you go and pull something like this on me.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: While you were unconscious, I looked at your evidence biochip.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: That's some pretty incriminating stuff.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Looks like I've got no choice.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I'm going to have to erase it and ... uh ...

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: mind wipe you.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Well,

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: at least you won't remember how painful it was.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: In fact, when you wake up back in your apartment in the year 2319,

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: you won't remember that any of this ever happened.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Or ... uh ... will happen, I guess.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Well, first I .. I've got to send back the, uh, environ cart that you stole from me.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Well, despite your best efforts, humans are no longer the only beings capable of time travel.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: It's for the better, Gage, believe me.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: We can't ... we just can't be trusted with ... with such a powerful tool.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Human nature would eventually drive us to use it for the wrong reasons.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: And if we're not the only ones with the technology, maybe we won't be as tempted to misuse it.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: My contact promised me that it would be given to every race of the Symbiotry that wants it.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: You probably think that I'm ill, that, uh, I'm insane.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I really can't blame you.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I mean, no one from our generation has ever seen how aggressive we can really be.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Or, the generation before us, for that matter, or, the one before that.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: But, every single one of my historical research missions involved studying war.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I've been to the Nazi death camps ...

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: ... and Hiroshima ...

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I've seen the terrorist massacres.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I've lived it. I know.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: You can't possibly imagine the horror of seeing a bustling city of thousands

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: vaporized by a nuclear firestorm,

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: or a crowd of people shredded into bloody ribbons by a single shrap' bomb, as you watch, helpless.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: But that's what happens when we feel the need to bear our teeth.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: It's human nature, and it's not something that ... that just a couple hundred years can ... can erase.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Look around you. Do you know what this place is?

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: It's a ... it's a missile silo.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Well, few centuries ago, there were tens of thousands of these,

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: and each one contained a nuclear missile powerful enough to obliterate an entire sector.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: That's enough to destroy the world 50 times over.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Yet just three centuries later, even before the physical reminders are gone,

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: we're claiming that we've matured into a peaceful race of beings.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: How can we be that naive?

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: You probably figured out that I was the one that rigged the security grid.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I had to be able to get the things I needed from the Pegasus warehouse without being seen.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: But when you started asking around about the mistake in the grid, well, I mean the future you, that is,

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I had to change my plans.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: So, instead of just sending the information to my contact,

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I came up with the idea of hiding it in historical artifacts.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Artifacts from your research dates that were also slated for sale at the Louvre art auction.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: That way, all I had to do was tell my contact which items to buy.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: And the transaction was nearly impossible to trace.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: And, if anyone started digging around because of what they saw,

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: well, they'd discover the ripples and come straight back to you.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I even found some valuable trinkets to plant in your locker if that happened.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Just that one simple move would give you a motive...

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: ...and the court a scapegoat.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: But, um, I didn't want to have to do it.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I never thought for a second that someone might accidentally discover the ripples.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I mean, how often do we do manual scans?

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Someone must have been bored out of their mind that day.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I'm sorry, Gage. I really am.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: If I could be the one that was arrested,

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: if I could take responsibility for my actions, I would in a second, believe me.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I had no choice.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I ... I don't want to do this to you, but

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: if I don't, it will all have been for nothing.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: If they find out how the technology was spread, they'll be able to keep it from ever happening.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: That's ... that's the problem with time travel.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Nothing's ever safe.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: That's why I had to do it.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I had to even the playing field, even a little.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: I'm sorry if ... if I'm making you an unwilling martyr to my cause,

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: but that's just the way it's got to be.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Please understand.

subtitles.speaker: Michelle (Agent 3)
subtitles.text: Why am I even bothering with this? You're not going to remember any of this anyway.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Uh-oh, Gage. This doesn't look good.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: The jump controls are locked out, and she's got you completely immobilized.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: While you were taking a commercial break, she hooked us up to this thing.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: She's been downloading stuff from your biochips ever since.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: She hasn't discovered me yet, but I'm afraid it's just a matter of time.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I keep trying to sneak a peek down the data stream,

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: but I'm afraid I'm going to stand out like a ... like a ... rat in the garden house.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Hey, that was pretty good!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Anyway, I'll keep trying.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: That's it!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: She just hooked up the pipeline I needed!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I'm going to swim him up and see if I can stop her!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Gage, we're running out of options here.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I need that password now!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Think of something, anything, pets, hobbies, power tools, types of cheeses, something personal!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: She's passed the last safety lockout, Gage.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: If you don't get me in there now, our minds might not be the only things erased.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: History could be in for a serious rewrite.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: We're the only ones, Gage.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: We've got to do it ... now.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Haha! That's it! We're in!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Only... there's one thing I didn't tell you, Gage...

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: You're going to have to do the rest without me.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I'm the virus!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Thanks for the adventure.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I'll see you on the other side.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Gage, I'm there. It's all hooked up, everything!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: It's all controlled through the neural link into her suit.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: We can create a virus and shut the whole thing down!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: I just need to get into...

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: Oh, no.

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
subtitles.text: There's a password, Gage. I need a password!

subtitles.speaker: Arthur
